summary: trainer-operator (also known as: Trainer operator, Kubeflow Trainer operator) is a Kubernetes component. managing 1 CRD(s): Trainer. deploying 4 workload(s) (controller-manager, kubeflow-trainer-controller-manager, kubeflow-trainer-controller-manager, kubeflow-trainer-controller-manager) with 4 container(s). watching 4 resource type(s). defining 1 API spec type(s) across 5 struct(s) with 14 total fields. with 39 operator config constants (2 image references). integrates with management relationship via labels/annotations. kustomize overlays: config/crd, config/default, config/manager, config/manifests, config/network-policy, config/prometheus, config/rbac, config/scorecard. mounts 1 ConfigMap(s) as volumes: kubeflow-trainer-config.

security_annotations.description: Workflow "Disconnected Readiness" has no top-level permissions block. Without explicit permissions, the GITHUB_TOKEN gets default permissions which may be overly broad (write access to contents, packages, etc.).
